run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the median of two sorted arrays of equal length n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
review_f_gold: review f_gold which finds the median of two sorted arrays using a merge-like approach
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a binary search approach instead of the O(n) merge traversal
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which tracks the last two values during a merge to compute the median
